title: Cubea
summary: A low-poly top-down game of the Cuban Revolution that runs in your browser. Play it free.
seoDescription: Cubea: a free browser game by Sebastian Harder. A low-poly, top-down game of the Cuban Revolution where every cube is a person with a family, friends and a job.
description:
A low-poly 2D top-down game of the Cuban Revolution, where every cube is a person with a family, friends, a job and a memory.

It runs in any browser with nothing to install. The game is still being built, so expect it to change often.
